title: HelpSuggestionsRequest
description: An inhabitant needs something it could not get by its own effort (B6 R8, F5238) or knocks at the glass (R10). The core lists what is missing and which object types it would allow as a gift; the service proposes 2-3 helps. Gifts are only proposed when the core has confirmed that the need cannot be met in the reachable world.

seed.description: Sampling seed derived by the core from world seed and tick (determinism).

deadline_ms.description: Wall-clock budget; when exceeded the service answers ServiceError 'timeout' and never makes a substitute decision.

trigger.description: knock = knocked at the glass; futile_effort = repeated failed attempts (threshold in content/player/gift_rules.json).

missing.description: What the inhabitant lacks, as need, property or object type ids; sorted by the core.

allowed_gifts.description: Object types the core would accept as a gift now (physics, tech level, reachability checked). Empty = no gift possible, only answers.

max_amount.description: Upper bound the core allows (logical amount, not pushing the game).
